title: Todo list
description: The floor reference app: single-table CRUD, user-scoped live query, realtime updates, reset/seed, and structured diagnostics, consumed by a headless surface and a Contract/Exact surface over one generated Snapback backend.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch); cargo to build/run the local server

contract.browserRunner: bun install --cwd demos/todo/surfaces/contract (once), then bun run --cwd demos/todo/surfaces/contract dev — the @expo/snapback-vite plugin (LLP 0030) attaches to or spawns the backend via the ready-file handshake, loads generated schema/functions + seed during bring-up, and relays app routes at /__snapback; SNAPBACK_TODO_API=<url> switches to external mode (Exact consumed from registry aliases; bun.lock is the pin)
contract.build: bun run --cwd demos/todo/surfaces/contract build (vite build via the exactContractWeb preset -> surfaces/contract/dist/web/)

exact.resolver: demos/_kit/exact-resolver.mjs (installed locked packages by default; SNAPBACK_EXACT_ROOT or .snapback/local.json is an explicit checkout override)
exact.toolchain: bun (to load published Exact TS package exports or a local checkout override)

react.note: Historical scoping (2026-Q1, snapback.v0): this demo predates the React/Expo adapter and deliberately ships no React surface. The first-party adapter has since shipped — see guide/capabilities.md (clients.react, clients.react-expo) and packages/snapback-cli/templates/react; the headless SnapbackClient remains the framework-neutral core it binds over.

headless: ready-descriptor dev-identity custody admits the current boot and generically refuses a mismatched capability
JavaScript ctx.db create/toggle/delete mutations plus HostPlan edit-title coverage
admin runner exposes captured handler read/write facts
realtime update reaches a second client
websocket stream pushes live replace without outbox polling
realtime matcher skips unrelated user-scoped mutations and records liveDelivery skip counts
realtime matcher skips hidden row patch/delete changes without leaking existence
realtime matcher uses captured In predicates beyond auth scope
range and limited-boundary matcher capability forms are reported
contract: contract bindings resolve to generated Snapback descriptors
mounts against live backend; renders live snapshot
Contract action drives a Snapback mutation (optimistic update)
Contract actions toggle completion and delete through Snapback mutations
mutation is server-authoritative and visible to headless surface (cross-surface)
provider seam subscribe + mutate on live backend
no demo-local Contract sidecars are required

capabilityGapsBoundary.reason: Frozen snapback.v0 demo-scoping record; entries are historical demo nonclaims and may contradict current platform maturity.

capabilityGapsNote: Frozen at demo-scoping time (2026-Q1, snapback.v0): entries record what this demo does not exercise, not current platform capability. Several have since shipped or partially shipped — react_adapter (clients.react shipped), assets (backend.assets partial), cron (backend.cron shipped), notifications (backend.expo-push-seam shipped; first-class backend.notifications remains a GAP), external_auth (auth.external-identity-broker partial). guide/capabilities.md is the current capability truth.
notClaiming: offline-first / local handler replay (this is an Online-class integration)
Partiful-scale throughput (this is a demo shape, not a benchmark)
full JavaScript handler coverage (list/create/setCompleted/delete use ctx.db; listTodosOnce/editTitle remain HostPlan fixture paths)
automatic mutation retry (v0 rejects conflicts with a structured diagnostic)
incremental delta transport (current websocket and deterministic drain paths both deliver live_replace payloads)
